title: New Orleans players in the shows, trumpeter Mason, back to Louisville
summary: Asked about New Orleans men in the Rabbit's Foot, he recalls none but praises trumpeter Mason, stays about a year, then returns to Louisville dance bands.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Is there any fellows from New Orleans in the band that you can remember? In the Rabbit's Foot...

I can't remember any fellows from New Orleans... Let's see... No... I can't remember any of the boys from New Orleans... There was... No... No... No I can't... But there was a very good trumpet player there... But there was a very good trumpet player there... But I was always... Tip된 stuff...

at working with the good trumpet players. This boy named Mason, I believe his name, very good. He played solos. They do a lot of that, they give concerts. He's very good. So I worked with them for, oh I guess, about a year or more to stay on them. And I went back to Louisville. And I stayed around Louisville there for a good while until, oh, until 20. Well, I came back and worked around with the dance bands around there. And then I left, left Louisville
